# OmniMem

> OmniMem is a self-hosted AI memory server — an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that gives AI agents persistent semantic memory across sessions, projects, and machines. Open source, MIT licensed, free forever.

OmniMem stores episodic memories, project context, knowledge articles, preferences, and compiled skills in Valkey with HNSW vector search. It features a memory lifecycle (active → deprioritised → archived → deleted), an abandoned-approach graveyard, experience scoring, contradiction detection, semantic deduplication, and RSS knowledge ingestion. It works with any MCP-capable agent: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, OpenCode, Kiro, GitHub Copilot, GitLab Duo, and Cursor.

## Docs

- [Source repository](https://codeberg.org/ric_harvey/omnimem): full README, manual, and deployment guides
- [Install](https://omnimem.org/#quickstart): `curl -fsSL https://codeberg.org/ric_harvey/omnimem/raw/branch/main/install.sh | bash`

## Key facts

- Self-hosted via Docker Compose (four containers: Valkey with vector search, MCP server, RSS worker, web dashboard)
- Python 3.12, FastMCP, sentence-transformers embeddings, Prometheus /metrics
- No SaaS, no telemetry to third parties, MIT licensed
